# PRV-SEC-02

**Does every connector that carries personal data authenticate the caller and authorise the call?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Privacy by design](privacy.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | SEC: Protection |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `connectors.data`, `connectors.authentication`, `connectors.authorisation`, `data.personal` |

## Why it matters

A connector carrying personal data with no authentication or authorisation is an open door to it, however well the store is protected.

## Rule

Every connector whose data names a data set with personal true states authentication and authorisation, neither of them none.

## Sources

- Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Article 32, security of processing. (`gdpr-32`)
- ISO/IEC 27701, Privacy information management systems, requirements and guidance. (`iso-27701`)
